title: Against All Odds
excerpt: We are a small, independent game studio, currently working on our first game.
content_html:
SEEDS

Survive

You're stranded on a lonely, desolate planet deep in space. Well, it won't stay lonely for long…
(COMING SOON)

Story

Uncover the secrets of the planet with more than 30 hours of story.
(COMING SOON)

Sandbox

Experience infinite freedom to terraform and totally reshape and replant your planet.

Creative

Build machines, alien villages, and biospheres. Decorate your home base. Research machines.

SEEDS starts in Early Access and is in active development, which means it isn't feature-complete yet. For now, it begins as an open-ended sandbox: reshape and terraform the planet, experiment with its ecosystem, collect resources, construct machines, place plants and items, and shape the world in your own way. Fly the spaceship and ride your hoverboard. Explore as ROBO unit RB-23, your companion in misfortune. Enjoy the beautiful scenery you create and take snapshots of it.

Terraform

Make the Planet habitable

Deploy machines to bring back atmosphere, water, and nutrients. Reshape the planet's surface to your likening, build ponds, bridges and rivers, and more… Renaturize and bring back life on the planet.

Create

Plant the Seeds

Grow a variety of plants and flowers, plant trees, and create an intact ecosystem.

Discover

Attract Animals and Aliens

Discover a lost civilization, attract and interact with them and various animal species.

Mine & collect

Gather Artefacts and Resources

To survive and make the planet habitable you have to gather resources and build machines. Discover lost artefacts on the way.

Defend

Defend the Planet From Hazards

If you wish so, you can make living on the planet a bit more challenging by having to defend it from asteroids, as well as drone and alien invasions. But you'll always have the option to play completely peacefully!

Evolving

SEEDS is a constantly growing experience

We keep developing SEEDS so that the game and everything on the planet can grow and expand.

The current version of the game features a sandbox mode where you can terraform and (re)shape the planet's surface, add water, build machines and an atmosphere, place decorative plants and other items, have plants growing and animals roaming, decorate your home base, and even play little arcade and puzzle games within the game. You can also fly around the planet and out to the asteroid belt in the spaceship.

The in-game computer is a complete 64-bit RISC-V virtual machine running an unmodified Linux kernel and a slightly modified Alpine Linux distribution. It runs all in-game programs, such as research in story mode, and already lets you play small games on the monitors in your base or spaceship. You can also play a game of chess and a certain kind of block-stacking game on the hologram table inside your base. You're also able to program the computer in the language of your choice and run your own programs on it. Later, you'll also be able to influence and automate your sandbox from within this computer.

But this is only the beginning. We are working on a survival mode and a story mode, which both keep all the features of the sandbox mode, but tied to your progress and more challenging. Story mode adds the tale of our protagonist Naxiah and the Echoes Beneath the Sands she discovers, a story we want to tell and you get to experience. It will turn your arrival on the planet into a journey, a discovery, a planetary canvas of choices and expectations. Explore the hidden world and uncover its secrets and history, learn more about the life it harbors, all while working with resources and blueprints to research and build new things as the story unfolds.

Alongside the survival and story modes, we are gradually adding new features to SEEDS, which are released to a smaller circle of beta testers and are then made available to everyone in the Early Access version.

Available: Q4/2026 Wishlist on Steam
